description:
Advisory TTL path intent and overlap notices. Never lock, pause, or reject writes.

## Background

Shared checkout is normal. Intent is a hint, not ownership. Shell writes may be invisible. Do not claim safety. Do not create worktrees. Observing edit-tool paths is deferred.

## Behavior

- Announce paths + TTL; expire automatically.
- On overlap of declared paths: notify live agents, name the other child's description, suggest a direct message, surface metadata for the parent on the next real packet (not a spam wake).
- Continue execution.

## Success criteria

- Overlap never rejects an edit.
- Expired intent disappears without implying the agent stopped touching the path.

## Test plan

- Unit: TTL expiry.
- Unit: overlap notice contents.
- Unit: no enforcement action.

## Considerations

Spawn children are not in the group; they do not announce. Fine.
title: Add advisory TTL path intent and overlap notices
